verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is an agentic-commerce platform, so product or offer discovery is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence, however, covers only payment tokens, purchase-intent mandates, credential retrieval, agent signatures via the Trusted Agent Protocol, and merchant-side Pay by Link and invoice creation. Nothing documents machine-readable offer data such as price, availability, variants or checkout links for listed products; creating payment links is an adjacent merchant feature, not offer discovery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read machine-readable offer data — price, availability, variants, checkout links — for any listed product or service
